title: A coprime factorization of a monic polynomial modulo I lifts after an etale extension trivial modulo I
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $f\in A[x]$ a monic polynomial. Let $\bar f=\bar g\bar h$ be a factorization of the image $\bar f$ of $f$ in $(A/I)[x]$ such that (1) the leading coefficient of $\bar g$ is a unit of $A/I$, and (2) $\bar g$ and $\bar h$ generate the unit ideal of $(A/I)[x]$. Then there exist a ring map $A\to A'$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the induced map $\alpha:A/I\to A'/IA'$ is an isomorphism, and polynomials $g',h'\in A'[x]$ with $f=g'h'$ in $A'[x]$ (with $f$ mapped to $A'[x]$) lifting the given factorization: the images of $g'$ and $h'$ in $(A'/IA')[x]$ are the images of $\bar g$ and $\bar h$ under $\alpha$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M1 (lemma-lift-factorization-easy) and its proof (uses Lemma Tag 07LX lemma-lift-invertible-element and Lemma Tag 0ALH lemma-lift-factorization-monic; the latter uses Algebra Example Tag 00UA, the universal factorization ring, and Lemma Tag 07M0 lemma-localize-upstairs)
